name: Points At
description: A ref resolves to a commit — the branch head or the tag's commit (for an annotated tag, the commit the tag object points at, not the tag object). The join that lets a ruleset's required-signatures rule be checked against what is actually on the protected ref. Property-free: movement is field history on git_ref.head_sha and every write carries batch provenance, so the corpus's `observed_at` would be a second derivation of a fact the grid already keeps. A ref that moves gets a new edge; the old one is a relation that was re-derived, not one that ended (github-core#14, shape G).
